Bloom Filters. To speed up point lookups, which are common in practice [16, 48], each run has a Bloom filter [14] in main memory, as shown in Figure 2. A Bloom filter is a space-efficient probabilistic data structure used to answer set membership queries. It cannot return a false negative, though it returns a false positive with a tunable false positive rate (FPR).
